turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> M{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    M -->|Received document| AS1[Run floor nouns against document]
    AS1 --> AS2[Compress to residue in STE]
    AS2 --> AS3[Report residue, evaporation, operative sentence, and finding]
    AS3 --> AS4[This is a finding, not a draft.]
    AS4 --> STOP1([Stop])

    M -->|Draft prompt| B{Mode stated or inferable?}
    B -->|No| B1[Ask for mode]
    B1 --> W[Wait for answer]
    W --> C
    B -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| C[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    C -->|HUMAN| C1[Run the speak test]
    C1 --> D{Floor passes?}
    C -->|MACHINE| D

    D -->|No, 3 or fewer gaps| D1[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    D -->|No, 4 or more gaps| D2[Ask three largest gaps; state assumptions for the rest]
    D1 --> W
    D2 --> W
    D -->|Yes| E[Compress the prompt]

    E --> E1{Did the cut remove a specification?}
    E1 -->|Yes| E2[Name decorative or destructive cut; revert]
    E2 --> E
    E1 -->|No| E3{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    E3 -->|Yes| F[Contract is minimal]
    E3 -->|No| E4{Floor still passes?}
    E4 -->|No| E5[Return the last passing version]
    E5 --> F
    E4 -->|Yes| F

    F --> G[Output the optimized prompt, Cut line, and needed notes]
    G --> H{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    H -->|Keep negotiating| E
    H -->|Freeze, execute, or run it from the named human signer| I{Execution tools available?}
    I -->|No| I1[Gate stays closed; report no execution]
    I -->|Yes| I2[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    I2 --> J{Result}
    J -->|Success| K[Done]
    J -->|Floor failure| L[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    L --> E
```

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: D2 -> W, D1 -> W
